_readme: Bulk upload file for ONE language. Admin -> Bulk upload -> choose this file -> check the preview -> Import.
language.slug: same slug as an existing language = add questions to it (only the fields you write are changed).
language.isActive false = hidden from visitors until you activate it in Admin -> Languages.
topics: names in display order. question.topic: a topic name or slug from this list.
type: qa or mcq. difficulty: easy, medium or hard. isFree true = guests see it (free MCQs = sample quiz).
MCQ: exactly 4 different options + correctAnswer (the option text) or correctOption (0-3). answer = explanation.
Same question text again = that question is updated, not duplicated. Nothing is ever deleted.

language.name: JavaScript
language.description: The language of the web browser, also used on servers with Node.js. Covers basics, functions, async code and the DOM.

questions.question: What is the difference between let, const and var?
questions.answer: var is function-scoped and can be re-declared. let and const are block-scoped. const cannot be re-assigned, but an object or array stored in a const can still be changed.

questions.question: What is a closure?
questions.answer: A closure is a function that remembers the variables of the place where it was created, even after that outer function has finished running.

questions.question: What does typeof null return?
questions.answer: typeof null is "object". This is an old bug in JavaScript that was kept so existing websites do not break.

questions.question: In what order is this logged: console.log(1); setTimeout(() => console.log(2)); Promise.resolve().then(() => console.log(3)); console.log(4);
questions.answer: Normal code runs first (1, 4). Then promise callbacks (microtasks) run (3), and only after that timers (macrotasks) run (2).
